title: A note about Jordan's bound on the size of finite linear groups
summary: In 1878 Camille Jordan showed that every finite subgroup $G\le\text{GL}_n(\mathbb C)$ has an abelian normal subgroup $A$ such that $\lvert G/A\rvert$ is bounded in terms of $n$, but he did not give an explicit bound. An explicit bound was obtained by Blichfeldt in a series of papers beginning in 1904, using representation-theoretic methods. In 1911 Bieberbach gave a geometric proof, which is quite different from the approaches of Jordan and Blichfeldt, together with an explicit bound.
